purpose: Check primary regional data availability before adopting model catch or biomass allocation proxies
queries: site.fao.org/gfcm Mediterranean sardine anchovy hake red mullet catch age 2019 stock assessment basin
site.fao.org/gfcm Mediterranean 2019 landings species composition marine fishes nei

records.title: GFCM benchmark assessment of sardine and anchovy in GSAs 17 and 18
records.supports: The assessments are Adriatic sub-basin assessments with anchovy inputs through 2019; the sardine catch-at-age matrix retained unresolved uncertainty.
records.applicability: Not a compatible whole-Mediterranean caught-mass fraction for the selected 1995 Adult/Recruit definitions.
records.decision: No observed allocation adopted. Retain the existing four model total-removal stage ratios with Medium weight confidence.

records.title: GFCM stock assessment data and information
records.material_read: Full public page, data description and embedded dashboard links
records.supports: Stock assessment information exists for specific stocks; the visible page is a data portal rather than a species or stage mass-allocation table.
records.applicability: No selected-source cutoff or full-basin catch composition in material actually read.
records.decision: No weights inferred from the portal.

records.title: GFCM information management
records.material_read: Full data-management page, public-data and geographical-subarea descriptions
records.supports: GFCM publicly exposes a subset of national submissions, stock assessments and capture-production statistics; model-relevant assessments frequently operate by subarea.
records.applicability: No verified composition of broad Sea Around Us labels across the exact selected model groups.
records.decision: Use explicit eligible-group model landings proportions first, otherwise complete accepted biomass proportions. Both are Medium assumptions; source composition remains uncertain.

limitation: This bounded search did not establish compatible observed caught-mass shares. It does not show that raw sampling or assessment data do not exist. Unknown stage cutoffs remain unknown.
